# Study UI icons

These locally packaged SVGs are decorative; visible text supplies the control names.
They are copied into web/native builds and included in the PWA core cache.

- `copy`, `file-text`, `list`, `check-square`, `clock`, `target`, `menu`, `chevron-left`, `chevron-right`: unmodified assets from [Feather Icons](https://github.com/feathericons/feather/tree/main/icons), downloaded 28 November 2026. See `feather-LICENSE`.
- `play-circle`, `check-circle`, `x-circle`: unmodified 24px solid assets from [Heroicons](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/heroicons/tree/master/optimized/24/solid), downloaded 28 November 2026. See `heroicons-LICENSE`.

The Home card rotates the standard copy icon to echo the concept's stacked flashcards. CSS adjusts icon tone in light/dark themes and uses white icons on primary actions. No runtime CDN or icon-font dependency is used.
